_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：as if / as though 的用法（eng.t_adv.subj.as-if，學測／分科級）。與現在事實相反＝as if ＋ 過去式／were；與過去事實相反＝as if ＋ 過去完成式；若比較內容可能為真＝as if ＋ 一般現在式（直陳）。高階特別防第二正解：以句尾語境（but he is just…／clearly true）鎖定『與事實相反』或『可能為真』，區分 were（虛擬）vs is（直陳）。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: as if / as though 的虛擬語氣（與事實相反 vs 可能為真）
units.can_do: 我能用 as if／as though 表達與現在事實相反（過去式／were）、與過去事實相反（過去完成式），並能分辨當比較內容可能為真時改用一般現在式（直陳）。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 as if / as though
units.subject: eng

claims.text: For something contrary to a PRESENT fact, use 'as if / as though + past tense': He talks as if he owned the company (but he does not).
claims.verification_ref: 與現在相反＝as if ＋ 過去式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In the as-if clause, formal English uses 'were' for all persons: She acts as if she were the manager.
claims.verification_ref: 正式用法 as if ＋ were（各人稱）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: For something contrary to a PAST fact, use 'as if / as though + past perfect (had + past participle)': He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
claims.verification_ref: 與過去相反＝as if ＋ 過去完成式；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the comparison may actually be true or likely, 'as if / as though' takes an ordinary present tense (indicative): It looks as if it is going to rain.
claims.verification_ref: 若內容可能為真＝as if ＋ 一般現在式（直陳）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Use 'as if' or 'as though' to compare a situation to something imaginary. When the comparison is contrary to the PRESENT fact, use a past tense in the as-if clause. In formal English, use 'were' for all persons: 'He acts as if he were rich' means he is not rich.
teach.zh_hint: as if／as though 用來把情況比喻成某個想像的樣子。當比喻與「現在事實相反」時，as if 子句用過去式；正式用法各人稱都用 were：He acts as if he were rich 代表「他其實不有錢」。

teach.body: He talks as if he owned the whole company, but he is only an intern.
teach.zh_hint: 他講話好像整間公司是他的一樣，但他只是個實習生。owned＝過去式，表示與現在事實相反。

teach.body: When the comparison is contrary to a PAST fact, use the past perfect (had + past participle). But when the comparison may really be true or likely, keep an ordinary present tense (the indicative): 'It looks as if it is going to rain' — this may actually happen.
teach.zh_hint: 當比喻與「過去事實相反」時，用過去完成式（had ＋ 過去分詞）。但若比喻內容「可能真的如此」，就用一般現在式（直陳）：It looks as if it is going to rain——這有可能真的發生。

teach.body: She looked as if she had seen a ghost, though nothing was really there.
teach.zh_hint: 她看起來好像見到鬼一樣，雖然其實什麼都沒有。had seen＝過去完成式，表示與過去事實相反。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：He behaves as if he ____ the owner, but he is only a guest.（他表現得好像自己是主人，但他只是個客人）

distractor_rationales.is: but he is only a guest 清楚表示與現在事實相反，要用虛擬（過去式／were），不是直陳現在式 is。
distractor_rationales.has been: has been 是現在完成式，不用來表達與現在事實相反的比喻；用 were。
distractor_rationales.will be: will be 指未來，與此處「與現在事實相反」的比喻無關。

practice.feedback: 與現在事實相反：as if ＋ 過去式／were：He behaves as if he were the owner。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：She looked as if she ____ a ghost, but nothing was there.（她看起來好像見到鬼，但那裡什麼都沒有）

distractor_rationales.saw: 與過去事實相反的 as-if 子句用過去完成式 had seen，不是過去簡單式 saw。
distractor_rationales.sees: sees 是現在式，與此處「與過去事實相反」不合，時間也錯。
distractor_rationales.has seen: has seen 是現在完成式；與過去相反的比喻用過去完成式 had seen。

practice.feedback: 與過去事實相反：as if ＋ 過去完成式：She looked as if she had seen a ghost。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：The sky is very dark; it looks as if it ____ going to rain soon.（天很暗，看起來好像快下雨了——這很可能真的發生）

distractor_rationales.were: 這裡下雨「很可能真的發生」（可能為真），用一般現在式 is（直陳），不用表示與事實相反的 were。
distractor_rationales.had been: had been 是過去完成式，用於與過去相反；此處講的是很可能發生的現在／近未來。
distractor_rationales.be: 原形 be 不能單獨當述語動詞；可能為真時用 is。

practice.feedback: 比喻內容可能為真時用一般現在式（直陳）：it looks as if it is going to rain。

practice.stem: 選出正確表達「他其實不是醫生，卻裝得好像是」的句子：
practice.answer: He speaks as if he were a doctor, but he has no medical training.
options: He speaks as if he were a doctor, but he has no medical training.
He speaks as if he is a doctor, and he really is one.
He speaks as if he will be a doctor, but he has no medical training.
He speaks as if he had been a doctor, but he has no medical training.

distractor_rationales.He speaks as if he is a doctor, and he r: 用 is（直陳）且 and he really is one 代表「真的是醫生」，與題意「其實不是」相反。
distractor_rationales.He speaks as if he will be a doctor, but: will be 指未來，不表達「與現在事實相反」的比喻。
distractor_rationales.He speaks as if he had been a doctor, bu: had been 是過去完成式，講與過去相反；題意是與「現在」事實相反，用 were。

practice.feedback: 與現在事實相反用 as if ＋ were：He speaks as if he were a doctor。

practice.stem: 用 as if 改寫（與現在事實相反）：'He gives orders to everyone. You would think he is the boss, but he is not.'（寫出：He gives orders as if ...）
practice.answer: He gives orders as if he were the boss.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：as if 子句與現在事實相反用 were（He gives orders as if he were the boss）。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評，不自動判發音）：as if 前略停，were／had p.p. 稍清楚；對比子句（but he is only…）語氣稍下收。

lines.text: He talks as if he knew everything, but he often gets it wrong.
lines.intonation: as if 前略停、knew 稍清楚、but 轉折處稍停

lines.text: She looked as if she had run a marathon.
lines.intonation: had run 連讀輕讀、句尾下收
